Investigate intermittent frontend fetch failures in admin (network interceptor/proxy/runtime script path).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use existing admin creds from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Focus retest on: (1) 320px overflow, (2) admin fetch failures, (3) blog-new-post intermittency under fetch errors. Required screenshots already captured at 1920x800 and 390x844 in artifacts_iter5_ui.
rca of the issue: RCA: (a) 320 overflow likely from absolute decorative blob width (w-80) extending beyond viewport clipping context, plus neighboring flex sizing. (b) Blog UI timeout appears secondary to repeated runtime fetch failures in console; when data fetches fail repeatedly, state transitions become unstable and editor open action intermittently stalls. (c) Hydration warning originates from invalid DOM composition in ServiceLocationFinder option rendering (<span> inside <option>).
